name: Aim Charm (waves drop)
notes: A drop of the waves mode: the classic run's Aim Charm (a red and white target), with the same look and the same boost. A wave monster that faints has a 25% chance to drop one of the 5 items, picked at random (item 2 of drop_kind; at most 3 Aim Charms per run, see enm_wave_1). It appears at the monster's feet, or, when the monster fainted in the dark edge the player can't walk into, on the nearest spot of lit floor (free_spot). Only the player can pick it up (monsters walk over it): walking into it plays the item chime, floats '-5% MISS' over the player and the player's moves are 5 points more accurate for the rest of the run (boost_aim: a 95% move never misses). It adds to the same variable as the Aim Charm level-up card, so the two boosts add up. It stays on the floor until it is picked up or the run ends.
